messages.author: dea7fe9fc1920d2f
messages.subject: Combining custom tooltip and brush
parts:
Hi everybody, 

sorry for coming back to the brush again, but for me it's clearly the most interesting function in ggvis. I would like to show an informative tooltip, and also have brushing function so you can identify objects via tooltip and track their position in multiple plots using the brush.

In parts of this work fine, but not the whole thing.

In the first example I show the name of a car in the tooltip:

# custom tooltip works
library(ggvis)
myMtcars <- mtcars
myMtcars$keys <- seq(1, nrow(myMtcars))  
show_model <- function(x=NULL) {
if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
key <- x["keys"][[1]]
rownames(myMtcars)[key]
}  
ggvis(myMtcars, props(x = ~disp, y = ~mpg,  size.brush := 400, key := ~keys)) +
layer_point() + tooltip(show_model)

This plot shows the brush in combination with a simple tooltip:

# brush with simple tooltip works
library(ggvis)
myMtcars <- mtcars

lb <- linked_brush(keys = 1:nrow(myMtcars))

all_values <- function(x) {
if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
paste0(names(x), ": ", format(x), collapse = "<br />")
}
ggvis(myMtcars, props(x = ~disp, y = ~mpg, fill := lb$fill_prop(), size.brush := 400)) +
layer_point() + lb$brush_handler() + tooltip(all_values)


Putting it all together I try to show the car model again in the tooltip and to demonstrate the brush

# brush with custom tooltip doesnt work
library(ggvis)
myMtcars <- mtcars
myMtcars$keys <- seq(1, nrow(myMtcars))
 
lb <- linked_brush(keys = 1:nrow(myMtcars))
 
show_model <- function(x=NULL) {
if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
print(x)
key <- x["keys"][[1]]
rownames(myMtcars)[key]
}  
ggvis(myMtcars, props(x = ~disp, y = ~mpg, fill := lb$fill_prop(), size.brush := 400, key := ~keys)) +
layer_point() + lb$brush_handler() + tooltip(show_model)

Here the tooltip works, but once the brush touches the first point it breaks:

Error in keys + 1 : non-numeric argument to binary operator

What's wrong?

Thanks a lot

Thomas

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Combining custom tooltip and brush
parts:
Hi Thomas,

Currently there's a bug which means that you can't use non-numeric keys.

Hadley

Hadley,

as far as I can see there are two keys in my third example. The key for the brush is 1:nrow(myMtcars), and the key for the tooltip is seq(1, nrow(myMtcars). Both are numeric.

Best

Thomas
